attacks.name: Concussion Blasts
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Discombobulate|: After this attack is resolved, for each |!wild| in the attack roll, the defender gains 1 of the following special conditions: |§slow§Slow| or |§stun§Stun|.

attacks.name: Energy Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Push|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, Push it Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: The Once and Future Iron Lad
steps: This character may reroll any number of attack dice for this attack.

superPowers.name: Neurokinetic Armor
superPowers.body: This character removes 1 |!damage| or special condition from itself. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Strength Actuators
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 2 or less within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Temporal Divergence
superPowers.body: When this character is defending, during the |*Modify Opponent's Dice| step of the attack, it may use this superpower. This character may reroll up to 2 of the attacker's dice. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.
